message.content:
This editorial illustration, presented as a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large white letters, depicts a confrontation on a green field with a white line. On the left, a man in a black referee uniform and black sneakers blows a red whistle. He has graying hair, glasses, and a circular patch on his sleeve featuring an emblem. 

Facing him are three men in white athletic shirts with red trim and white pants. The central man is depicted with an exaggeratedly large torso, shouting directly into the referee’s face while gesturing with open hands. Behind him, a man with glasses raises a clenched fist, while another man to the right leans forward with his hands on his hips and a smirk.

The background is a solid light green. Bold black text across the lower center reads "SESUMBAR BERANG 22 MEI," with smaller text below starting with "TAK MENERIMA HASIL PEMILU..." Top headers include "LIPUTAN KHUSUS: PEREMPUAN PENEMU" and "PONTANG-PANTING TARIF PESAWAT." A barcode and date "20-26 MEI 2019" appear in the bottom right.
